title: My Weekend
topic:
以 'My Weekend' 为题，写一篇不少于 50 词的短文，介绍你的周末活动。要求：1. 语句通顺，语法正确，内容完整，字迹工整；2. 不少于5句话。

参考词汇：busy忙碌的，happy快乐的，did my homework做我的作业，played football踢足球，watched TV看电视，cleaned my room打扫我的房间，went shopping去购物，visited my grandparents探望我的祖父母
参考句型：I ... ；We ...
时态要求：一般过去时
人称要求：第一人称
词数要求：不少于50词

scoring_criteria.reference_vocab: busy忙碌的，happy快乐的，did my homework做我的作业，played football踢足球，watched TV看电视，cleaned my room打扫我的房间，went shopping去购物，visited my grandparents探望我的祖父母
scoring_criteria.reference_sample:
My Weekend

I had a busy but happy weekend. On Saturday morning, I did my homework. In the afternoon, I played football with my friends. In the evening, I watched TV with my family. On Sunday, I cleaned my room and went to the park with my parents in the morning. In the afternoon, we went shopping and visited my grandparents. I had a great time.

title: Writing Task 02
topic:
根据所给开头和提示，写一篇小短文，描述一次你和家人或朋友的野餐经历，要求语句通顺，时态正确，不少于 50 个单词。
写作提示：时间(last Sunday/last Saturday)；地点(in the park/by the lake)；活动(have a picnic, eat food, fly kites, take photos...)；心情(happy, great, a funny day...)。
开头：The sun is shining in the sky.

参考词汇：have a picnic野餐，fly kites放风筝，take photos照相
参考句型：My mother...；My father...；We...
时态要求：一般现在时和一般过去时
人称要求：第一人称
词数要求：不少于50词
passage: The sun is shining in the sky.

scoring_criteria.reference_vocab: have a picnic野餐，fly kites放风筝，take photos照相
scoring_criteria.reference_sentences: My mother...；My father...；We...
scoring_criteria.tense_requirement: 一般现在时和一般过去时
scoring_criteria.reference_sample: The sun is shining in the sky. Last Sunday, I had a picnic with my family by the lake in the park. My mother prepared lots of delicious food, like bread, fruit and sandwiches. My father bought some cola and juice. My little sister and I flew kites, and the kites flew high in the sky. My father took many nice photos for us. We ate the food and talked happily together. We all had a great time. It was a really funny and happy day for my family.

title: Dragon Boat Festival
topic:

参考词汇：Dragon Boat Festival端午节，traditional传统的，festival节日，May五月，June六月，celebrate庆祝，Qu Yuan屈原，custom习俗，rice dumplings粽子，salted duck eggs咸鸭蛋，dragon boat race龙舟赛，happy开心的
参考句型：Dragon Boat Festival is...；It is in...；People celebrate it to...；People eat...；I like... because...
时态要求：一般现在时
人称要求：第一人称单数和第三人称复数
词数要求：不少于5句话

scoring_criteria.reference_vocab: Dragon Boat Festival端午节，traditional传统的，festival节日，May五月，June六月，celebrate庆祝，Qu Yuan屈原，custom习俗，rice dumplings粽子，salted duck eggs咸鸭蛋，dragon boat race龙舟赛，happy开心的

scoring_criteria.person_requirement: 第一人称单数和第三人称复数
scoring_criteria.reference_sample:
Dragon Boat Festival

In China, Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional festival. It is usually in May or June. People celebrate this festival to remember Qu Yuan. There are many interesting customs. People eat rice dumplings, salted duck eggs and watch dragon boat races. I like this festival very much, because I can have a good time with my family.

topic:

人称要求：第一人称
词数要求：60-70词

My winter holiday was wonderful. I went to Hainan with my family. We swam in the sea and ate fresh seafood there. I also visited my grandparents in the country. I helped them clean the house and feed the chickens. Besides, I learned to make yuanxiao with my mom for the Lantern Festival. I had a really happy winter holiday.

My favorite animal is the panda. It is black and white, with a round face and big, cute eyes. Pandas love to eat bamboo, and they spend most of their day munching on it. I hope to see a real panda one day!

How to Protect Our Environment

Today there is more and more pollution and the environment is becoming worse and worse. So we have to know how to protect the environment. Here are some ways. First, we shouldn't drop litter anywhere; we should put it into the trash bin. And it's best to pick up the litter on the ground when we see it. Second, we can stop driving our personal cars. We can go to school or work on foot or by bus. Not only can it protect the environment, but also it is good for our health. Third, we should save the paper, the water, the food and so on. Fourth, we should protect the trees and we should plant more trees. I think if everyone does something to protect the environment, our world will be much better and more beautiful.
